##### Project general facts

Mondrian is a striking beachfront development that seamlessly blends contemporary architecture with the natural beauty of Al Marjan Island. Inspired by the fluidity of the sea and the rhythm of coastal landscapes, the design features organic forms, stacked balconies, and expansive glass facades that maximize natural light and uninterrupted ocean views. The complex offers a selection of residences, from one- to three-bedroom apartments to townhouses, a penthouse, and sky villas. Each residence is thoughtfully positioned to create a harmonious connection between indoor and outdoor living, offering a serene and elevated lifestyle defined by openness, elegance, and a deep relationship with the surrounding environment.

The development offers a curated selection of world-class amenities designed to enrich every aspect of daily life. Residents enjoy direct beach access, landscaped courtyards, rooftop infinity pools, a private Sky Club, fitness and wellness facilities, and dedicated spaces for relaxation and social interaction. From fine dining experiences like Fi’lia by the Beach to family-friendly areas and wellness zones including sauna, cold plunge pools, and outdoor gyms, every detail is crafted to provide a balanced lifestyle—whether active, social, or tranquil.

Interiors at Mondrian reflect a refined blend of luxury and functionality, featuring high ceilings, bespoke finishes, and premium materials throughout. Residences are equipped with custom cabinetry, natural stone surfaces, and integrated appliances from leading brands such as Miele and Gaggenau. With a range of layouts from one-bedroom apartments to expansive sky villas and beachfront townhouses, each home is designed with meticulous attention to detail, delivering comfort, sophistication, and a distinctive sense of modern coastal living.

##### Location description and benefits

Al Marjan Island is one of the most prestigious coastal destinations in the United Arab Emirates, offering an exceptional combination of natural beauty, modern infrastructure, and resort-style living. This purpose-built island archipelago is known for its crystal-clear waters, expansive beaches, and thoughtfully designed waterfront communities, creating an atmosphere of tranquility and exclusivity that attracts both residents and international investors.

The island benefits from proximity to one of the region’s most exciting upcoming leisure destinations, the renowned Wynn Al Marjan Island Resort. The arrival of this world-class resort and entertainment destination is expected to further elevate the island’s global profile, bringing a vibrant mix of luxury hospitality, fine dining, and premium entertainment experiences. At the same time, the surrounding emirate of Ras Al Khaimah is celebrated for its diverse natural landscapes, ranging from scenic mountain ranges to vast deserts and protected coastlines, creating a truly unique environment that blends adventure with relaxation.

Connectivity is another significant advantage of the area. The island enjoys convenient access to Ras Al Khaimah International Airport, as well as quick links to major transportation routes leading to Dubai and other key emirates. This accessibility allows residents to enjoy a peaceful seaside lifestyle while remaining closely connected to the region’s main business, cultural, and entertainment hubs. Combined with the island’s growing collection of luxury resorts, waterfront promenades, marinas, and leisure attractions, the location offers an exceptional environment for both lifestyle living and long-term investment potential.
